FINAL IVX REELS CLOSEOUT
FINISH EVERY REMAINING ITEM ONE BY ONE, DEPLOY, AND VERIFY LIVE

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Continue only in the existing IVX Holdings Expo application.

Do not create a new Reels module.
Do not redesign the approved Home card.
Do not return another long narrative before execution.
Do not mark code inspection as device verification.
Do not mark PARTIAL items as PASS.
Do not stop after implementing local code.

Current verified baseline:

- Home Reels preview size restored
- Home card capped at approved compact height
- Full-screen Reels uses vertical snap paging
- Landing Reels uses object-fit: cover
- Property/deal media synchronization works
- GitHub and production SHA parity reported
- Automated suite: 830 passed, 0 failed

Complete the remaining items below in order.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — FREEZE CURRENT REELS BASELINE
==================================================

Record:

- Repository
- Branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Production SHA
- Render deployment ID
- /version SHA
- Boot time
- Current APK version
- Current APK versionCode
- Current APK SHA-256
- Rollback SHA

Confirm:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA
=
Render API SHA
=
Render worker SHA
=
/version SHA

ITEM 1:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until the baseline is recorded.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — PROTECT THE HOME REELS CARD SIZE
==================================================

The approved Home presentation must remain compact.

Required behavior:

- Home Reels card is not full-screen
- Full-screen 9:16 remains only inside the Reels module
- Card height is responsive and capped at 520px
- No NaN dimensions
- No screenHeight dependency in the Home card
- No stretching
- No clipped controls
- No overlapping text
- No broken layout on small Android screens
- No broken layout on tablets
- No broken layout on mobile web

Add automated regression tests that fail if:

- Home card becomes full-screen
- feedHeight becomes NaN
- card exceeds approved bounds
- full Reel styling is applied to Home
- controls overflow the card

Return:

- Exact file
- Exact component
- Exact design values
- Screenshot comparison
- Regression test names

ITEM 2:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 3 — REAL ANDROID APK INSTALL
==================================================

Use the newest APK built from the exact production source SHA.

Install it on a physical Android phone.

Record:

- Device manufacturer
- Device model
- Android version
- APK version
- versionCode
- Package ID
- Installation timestamp
- Fresh-install result
- Update-install result
- APK SHA-256

Required proof:

- Installation screenshot
- App icon screenshot
- Application version screenshot
- Package-manager result
- Source SHA used for APK

ITEM 3:
PASS / FAIL

Code inspection alone is not acceptable.

==================================================
ITEM 4 — HOME REELS DEVICE QA
==================================================

On the physical phone:

1. Open Home.
2. Confirm Home loads without waiting for full video.
3. Confirm Reels card has the approved compact size.
4. Confirm poster image is sharp.
5. Confirm text and controls are visible.
6. Tap the card.
7. Confirm the selected Reel opens.
8. Return to Home.
9. Confirm Home scroll position is preserved.
10. Repeat 20 times.

Verify:

- No blank card
- No wrong dimensions
- No layout jumping
- No frozen poster
- No unexpected autoplay on Home
- No offscreen audio
- No duplicate player
- No crash
- No ANR

ITEM 4:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 5 — FULL REELS DEVICE QA
==================================================

Test the full Reels feed on a physical phone.

Required:

- Full viewport presentation
- Correct status-bar and navigation safe areas
- Vertical one-item snap paging
- One active video only
- Previous video pauses immediately
- Next video starts only when sufficiently visible
- Poster appears before the first frame
- Tap pause/play
- Mute/unmute
- Mute preference persists
- Background pauses playback
- Resume works
- Back navigation stops audio
- Retry works after playback failure

Test at least 25 different Reels.

ITEM 5:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 6 — REAL UPLOAD FROM DEVICE
==================================================

The existing report says upload was not device-tested.

Upload from the Android phone:

1. Vertical 1080 × 1920 MP4
2. Vertical 720 × 1280 MP4
3. Horizontal video
4. Video with audio
5. Video without audio
6. Large file
7. Short file
8. Rotated video
9. Unsupported format
10. Corrupted file

Verify:

- File validation
- Upload progress
- Cancel
- Retry
- Duplicate prevention
- Processing status
- Poster creation
- Correct orientation
- Correct audio
- Reel appears in Admin
- Reel appears in Reels
- Landing visibility follows settings
- Property/deal link is correct

Return:

- Media IDs
- Upload request IDs
- Processing records
- Poster URLs
- Final playback URLs
- Screenshots

ITEM 6:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 7 — VIDEO QUALITY AUDIT
==================================================

Measure actual video quality. Do not describe it only as “Instagram style.”

For each tested video return:

- Source resolution
- Delivered resolution
- Source bitrate
- Delivered bitrate
- Frame rate
- Codec
- Audio codec
- Time to first frame
- Buffering count
- Dropped-frame count
- Visible blur or compression
- Orientation result

Acceptance:

- No unnecessary resolution loss
- No stretched video
- No incorrect rotation
- No excessive compression
- Poster quality acceptable
- Audio synchronized
- Text inside source video remains readable

ITEM 7:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 8 — TRANSCODING AND ADAPTIVE STREAMING
==================================================

Current report says:

- Android uses original MP4 fallback
- Web/iOS may use HLS
- No multi-rendition server-side transcoding

Implement an IVX-controlled processing pipeline or integrate an approved media service.

Required renditions when supported by source:

- 1080p
- 720p
- 540p or 480p
- poster image
- preview thumbnail

Required behavior:

- Adaptive rendition selected based on network
- Original source preserved privately
- Transcoding idempotent
- Failed processing can retry
- Processing status stored
- No duplicate renditions
- Correct cache headers
- Signed/private source handling where required
- MP4 fallback remains available when HLS is unsupported

Do not mark this PASS until at least one real uploaded video is transcoded and each rendition is played successfully.

ITEM 8:
PASS / FAIL

If this feature is intentionally deferred, mark it DEFERRED, not PASS, and document the approved limitation.

==================================================
ITEM 9 — PRELOADING AND PLAYER LIFECYCLE
==================================================

Verify on the physical phone:

- Maximum three video players mounted
- Current video prepared immediately
- Next video preloaded
- Previous video retained only as designed
- Distant videos unmounted
- Network requests cancelled for distant items
- No duplicate subscriptions
- No hidden video playback
- No audio overlap
- Cache bounded
- Memory released when leaving Reels

Capture player and memory telemetry while scrolling.

ITEM 9:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 10 — PAGINATION AND DUPLICATE PREVENTION
==================================================

Test with enough records to force multiple pages.

Verify:

- Initial request is bounded
- Cursor pagination works
- Load-more works
- Refresh works
- Same Reel does not appear twice
- Stable IDs used
- Stable ordering
- Deleted Reel removed safely
- Hidden Reel not shown publicly
- Private Reel authorization enforced
- Returning to feed does not reset incorrectly
- Selected Reel opens by correct ID

Run at least:

- 10 refreshes
- 10 load-more operations
- repeated back/forward navigation
- account logout/login

ITEM 10:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 11 — 100-REEL LONG-SESSION TEST
==================================================

On the physical Android phone:

- Scroll through 100 Reels
- Play at least 50
- Open comments 20 times
- Like/unlike 20 times
- Save/unsave 10 times
- Share 10 times
- Open and close associated deals 10 times
- Background/resume 10 times
- Switch Home ↔ Reels 20 times

Run one 15-minute session and one 30-minute session.

Monitor:

- Crash
- ANR
- Memory usage
- CPU
- Battery
- Player count
- Network requests
- Buffering
- Dropped frames
- Duplicate subscriptions
- Audio overlap

Acceptance:

- 0 crashes
- 0 ANRs
- 0 unresolved frozen videos
- 0 audio overlaps
- No sustained memory growth
- No uncontrolled API request storm

ITEM 11:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 12 — NETWORK CONDITION QA
==================================================

Test:

1. Strong Wi-Fi
2. Normal 5G
3. Slow cellular network
4. High latency
5. Packet loss
6. Offline before opening Reels
7. Offline during playback
8. Offline during upload
9. Wi-Fi → cellular
10. Cellular → Wi-Fi
11. Connection restored after failure

Verify:

- Clear offline state
- Poster remains visible
- No infinite spinner
- Retry works
- Playback recovers
- Upload resumes or safely retries
- No duplicate media record
- No crash
- Adaptive quality changes where implemented

ITEM 12:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 13 — ACCESSIBILITY COMPLETION
==================================================

Current report is PARTIAL.

Complete:

- TalkBack test
- Accessible Reel description
- Accessible play/pause state
- Accessible mute state
- Accessible like/comment/share controls
- Correct focus order
- 44 × 44 minimum touch targets
- Dynamic text
- Captions/subtitles support
- Reduced-motion support
- Web keyboard navigation
- Visible focus indication
- Escape/back behavior
- No navigation trap

Implement reduced-motion behavior:

- Disable unnecessary animations
- Avoid aggressive autoplay transitions
- Preserve manual playback controls
- Respect the operating-system setting

ITEM 13:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 14 — PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT
==================================================

Current report has code optimization but no device measurements.

Measure on the physical Android device:

- Home first render
- Home Reels poster render
- Reels first render
- First-frame time
- Swipe-to-next response
- API p50
- API p95
- Buffering ratio
- Dropped frames
- Memory at start
- Memory after 25 Reels
- Memory after 50 Reels
- Memory after 100 Reels
- CPU average
- Battery use during 15 minutes
- Network usage per Reel

Return real numbers.

Do not return “optimized,” “fast,” or “Instagram quality” without measurements.

ITEM 14:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 15 — LANDING PAGE LIVE QA
==================================================

Test live on:

- Android Chrome
- Desktop Chrome
- Mobile Safari or approved iOS browser
- Desktop Safari when available

Verify:

- Correct vertical framing
- object-fit: cover
- No layout shift
- Poster loaded first
- Lazy loading
- No autoplay with sound
- Only visible video activates
- Scroll snap works
- Mobile touch works
- Desktop controls work
- Property/deal opens correctly
- No duplicate Reels
- No stale video after Admin update
- No download of every full video on page load

Use browser performance evidence.

ITEM 15:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 16 — ADMIN REELS QA
==================================================

Verify:

- Poster images show correctly
- 9:16 preview is correct
- Sync banner accurately reflects state
- Add Reel
- Edit Reel
- Replace video
- Replace poster
- Change order
- Feature/unfeature
- Hide/show
- Associate property/deal
- Remove Reel
- Restore or undo where supported
- Landing refresh
- App refresh
- Cache invalidation

Admin changes must synchronize to:

- Home
- Full Reels
- Landing page
- Property/deal card

ITEM 16:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 17 — INTERACTION QA
==================================================

Test live:

- Like
- Unlike
- Double-tap like
- Comment
- Delete own comment
- Owner moderation
- Share
- Native share sheet
- Copy link
- Save
- Unsave
- Report
- Open deal
- Invest Now

Verify:

- No duplicate likes
- No duplicate comments
- Counts reconcile after refresh
- Optimistic UI rolls back on failure
- Backend authorization enforced
- Repeated request is idempotent
- Links deep-link to correct Reel or deal

Implement the native share sheet before marking Share fully PASS.

ITEM 17:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 18 — AUTOMATED AND VISUAL REGRESSION
==================================================

Retain existing automated tests and add missing coverage for:

- Home compact size
- Full-screen variant
- NaN prevention
- Reduced motion
- Accessibility labels
- Pagination
- Duplicate prevention
- One-active-player rule
- Player unmounting
- Upload retry
- Upload idempotency
- Processing state
- Rendition selection
- Landing lazy loading
- Admin synchronization
- Share sheet
- Offline recovery

Run:

- TypeScript
- Lint
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- API tests
- Expo tests
- Security tests
- Visual-regression tests

Required:

- 0 failed tests
- 0 TypeScript errors in modified files
- no disabled failing test used to create a false PASS

ITEM 18:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 19 — FIX EVERY DEFECT FOUND
==================================================

For every failure:

1. Record defect ID.
2. Reproduce it.
3. Record screenshot or video.
4. Identify exact root cause.
5. Identify exact file and function.
6. Apply minimal fix.
7. Add regression test.
8. Run local validation.
9. Commit to the real GitHub repository.
10. Run CI.
11. Obtain owner deploy approval.
12. Deploy exact green SHA.
13. Verify /health and /version.
14. Retest on the physical device.
15. Retest on Landing.
16. Write proof-ledger record.

No local-only fixes.
No “will deploy later.”
No PASS without retest.

ITEM 19:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 20 — FINAL DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Deploy all Reels fixes together after CI is green.

Return:

- GitHub commit SHA
- Changed files
- CI run ID
- CI job results
- Render API deployment ID
- Render worker deployment ID
- Production SHA
- /version SHA
- Boot time
- APK build ID
- APK version
- APK versionCode
- APK SHA-256
- Permanent APK URL
- Deployment timestamp

Required parity:

/version SHA

APK source SHA

==================================================
FINAL CERTIFICATION
==================================================

HOME REELS:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAIL
